reviews.author: Ami And Ian Cook
paragraphs: Our son has just signed an Academy contract and this would not have been possible without BW Elite Goalkeeping. Want to say a massive thank you to Ben for not only coaching Henry to develop technically over the 5 years since he was 7 years old, but helping to install the confidence and mindset that is required to be a modern day goalkeeper and making it possible for this amazing opportunity.

We cannot recommend Ben and his fellow coaches highly enough for providing a fun and professional environment in either the group sessions or a detailed one to one coaching appointment, and his ability to work with children of all ages and abilities is second to none. Thank you.

reviews.author: Richard Finch
paragraphs: We have tried many goalkeeping coaches for our son without much success. Having found Ben has been amazing for our son, the improvement is there for all to see. Ben's scenarios and techniques are so different to any others and our son is so much more confident in he’s goalkeeping, the way Ben is with these kids is amazing and it’s so enjoyable to watch the sessions and see the kids enjoying the things they do.
Can’t thank Ben enough for what he does for the kids and if you want your son or daughter to benefit from great coaching for goalkeepers then I would highly recommend Ben and he’s team.

reviews.author: Darren Pearce
paragraphs: We’ve been looking for keeper training for our Son Ethan unsuccessfully then our club started working with Ben so we went ahead with some 1-2-1 sessions, all I can say is after 1 session the difference was noticeable, he then went to the Elite camp and walked out beaming telling us all about the skills and techniques he’d learnt! Then spent the next 4 hours in the garden practicing, Ben and his team are great at what they do, they make it not only interesting but fun and have given an 8 year old the dream of one day becoming a pro keeper! Thanks Ben!

reviews.author: Adrian Delaporte
paragraphs: My son has been working 1:1 with Ben for a year, sessions are planned around the individual and well delivered. Great coach, would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Louise Buckle
paragraphs: Ben has been working with our son for nearly a year. He is a great coach who has grown our son’s confidence in his goal keeping ability and also his understanding. But most of all, if our son is either attending a group session or having one on one, he always leaves with a smile on his face and asking when his next session is.

reviews.author: Lee Downes
paragraphs: My son has been working 1:1 with Ben for a year, and he absolutely relishes every session. Ben's ability to make sessions enjoyable yet challenging is brilliant.

reviews.author: Danielle Fletcher
paragraphs: Our experience with Ben has been an incredible one. Chelsea started his 1-2-1 sessions about 1 months ago and his progress has been incredible. With the help of Ben, Chelsea has excelled and has now signed with West Ham United. Ben is always ready to push Chelsea to his full potential.
His knowledge and passion for goalkeeping's never noticed. It has been an absolute pleasure to have him training my boy.
Would highly recommend. Great quality and value for money!

reviews.author: Kelly Sizer
paragraphs: After my son decided he wanted to become his football teams goalkeeper he asked if he could have some coaching to help him improve. I came across BW Goalkeeping and Fin started 1:1 sessions with Ben. Within a few weeks you could see how much Fin had benefited from these, he then went to do the group sessions. Over a year later he attends two group sessions a week and 1:1's when we can fit them in. Fins confidence has grown massively and his skills are improving weekly. He loves working along side the other goalkeepers at the group sessions. The coaches are fantastic, so supportive and encouraging. The sessions are always fun and energetic. Fin always comes home happy and looks forward to his next session.

reviews.author: Jackie Richards
paragraphs: My 10 year old was suffering from a lack of confidence with his goalkeeping so we booked him on a term with Ben and his team, and it has been the best thing we could have done for him and he has been going ever since.

Ollie's confidence and GK skills have really come on, and his football team coaches have also noticed a real improvement in his abilities. Ollie really enjoys his weekly sessions and I can't recommend Ben and the other coaches enough. Thank you!

reviews.author: Maria Lowry
paragraphs: We travel an hour just to attend Ben's camps and 1-2-1 sessions. My son loves going and always comes out buzzing. His skills in GK have improved a lot and it shows in his games. Would highly recommend Ben - he is a great coach with a lot of dedication to his trade.
